# Hibalag AI

> A Bisaya-speaking AI guide to Silliman University's Founders Week and the Hibalag Festival in August 2026 — schedule, venues, and itineraries.

Hibalag AI answers questions about the official Founders Day / Hibalag Festival
schedule in Bisaya, Tagalog, or English, and renders the schedule as a filterable
canvas by date and category (Featured, Religious, Alumni, Cultural, Parties).

## Pages

- [Hibalag AI](/): Chat with the festival guide and browse the interactive schedule canvas.

## Optional

- [MCP server](/mcp): Public Model Context Protocol endpoint exposing read-only festival schedule tools (`list_events`, `get_event`, `list_event_dates`).
